visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two anthropomorphic dogs, a Shiba Inu in an orange shirt and a white dog in a pink floral dress, stand before a large orange mushroom house in a bright theme park. They are taking a selfie with a smartphone mounted on a long selfie stick. (2) The pair is seated inside a red Ferris wheel gondola, grinning widely as they look at the phone screen. The background reveals a wide aerial view of an amusement park and distant hills under a clear blue sky. (3) While riding on a wooden horse on a brightly lit carousel, the Shiba dog accidentally fumbles his white smartphone. The device is captured mid-air, falling away from his reaching paws as the white dog watches in shock. (4) A close-up shows the phone lying face-down on a patterned pavement with a shattered screen. The Shiba dog is shown weeping with oversized animated tear streams, while the white dog rests a comforting hand on his shoulder in a soft-lit indoor setting. (5) The dogs walk through a pink door into a stylized house decorated with blue paw prints. Inside, the Shiba dog lies sadly in a blue bed while the white dog sits at a computer desk with a cat-shaped lamp. (6) The computer monitor displays the Chunghwa Telecom website featuring an 'iPhone 17 PRO' advertisement with promotional text in Traditional Chinese. The white dog appears to be carefully browsing the purchase options in a warm-lit room. (7) The white dog approaches the bed and presents a new orange-colored smartphone to the Shiba dog. He immediately stops crying and wakes up with a wide, joyful expression, his eyes sparkling with excitement. (8) Wearing pink and orange helmets, the dogs ride a white scooter through a modern city street. The Taipei 101 skyscraper is clearly visible in the background against a bright, hazy sky. (9) They arrive at a glass-fronted Chunghwa Telecom store. Inside, they are greeted by three anthropomorphic cats wearing blue staff uniforms. The cats wave and process the transaction at a clean, white service counter. (10) The dogs exit the store happily carrying a brown shopping bag. The final scene shows them riding a red roller coaster with their hands raised high, looking extremely exhilarated with wide-open mouths and joyous eyes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 中華電信 5G. (2) [Slogan]: iPhone 17 PRO 獨享市話最高送600分鐘, CHT Wi-Fi無限用. (3) [Slogan]: 舊機換iPhone 17現折$2,000 再送Apple購物金$2,000. (4) [Slogan]: 全台門市、網路涵蓋最廣, 提供您專業又貼心的服務! (5) [Slogan]: 中華電信 網速超快.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: No real humans are present; characters are anthropomorphic animals.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Two anthropomorphic dogs: a brown Shiba Inu wearing an orange tank top and a white fluffy dog wearing a pink floral dress.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between an amusement park with a Ferris wheel and carousel, a cozy pink-themed bedroom, a city street featuring Taipei 101, and a modern Chunghwa Telecom retail interior.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, bright electronic pop BGM begins with a heavy synth-bass beat. Rapid, joyful barking and laughing sound effects (SFX) are layered over the music. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' SFX indicates a scene change. The BGM maintains a driving energy. (3) A sudden 'thud' and sharp glass 'crack' SFX play as the phone drops. The BGM ducking occurs slightly. (4) Exaggerated cartoonish weeping SFX (high-pitched wailing) followed by a soft 'patting' sound and rhythmic breathing. (5) Sound of a door creaking open and heavy footsteps on wood. BGM becomes slightly muted and slower in tempo. (6) Fast 'clack-clack' keyboard typing SFX is heard clearly. A melodic 'ding' notification chime rings out twice. (7) BGM swells back to full volume. A scooter engine 'vroom' SFX and rushing wind noise enter the stereo field. (8) A cheerful 'ding-dong' retail bell SFX sounds. Three distinct friendly 'meow' vocalizations with rising pitch contours are heard. (9) The BGM hits a triumphant final chord. Intense wind-rush SFX and high-pitched joyful screaming sounds play as the roller coaster peaks and fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Chunghwa Telecom's mobile phone upgrade and network services using a cute, relatable animated story about replacing a broken phone.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of corporate logo, website, and specific promotional offer details for iPhone plans.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality animation with a consistent anthropomorphic character design targeting a broad consumer demographic in Taiwan.
